subject: Usage snapshot & target $/1M tokens — Apex Health next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@apexhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-01T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: usage snapshot & $/1M target

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks for the demo earlier today. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can map a hosted pricing proposal to your targets: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Expected steady-state monthly usage: ~100–140M tokens (mix of short prompt + medium-length responses).
- Peak TPS requirement: anticipated spikes up to ~15–20 TPS for 30–90s during batch report runs.
- Primary workload: document summarization + structured Q&A for clinical notes.
- Budget guidance: you mentioned a target unit economics number — want to confirm your target $/1M tokens.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm a baseline month (e.g., Dec) and a realistic 6‑month ramp profile (just 3 numbers: month1/month3/month6)?
2) Confirm target $/1M tokens for hosted API (ballpark is fine).
3) Any hard SLA or data residency constraints we should bake into pricing?

I attached a tiny worksheet for token estimates — feel free to drop your numbers and share. I’ll turn that into two options: (A) conservative hosted commit with modest discount, (B) flexible pay-as-you-go with burst buffer.

Proposed immediate next step: if you can reply with the two items above by EOD Friday, I’ll circulate a concise pricing slide and a suggested pilot agreement.

Thanks — talk soon,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Samir Desai <samir@apexhealth.com>

Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-02T09:11:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: usage snapshot & $/1M target

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the worksheet. Quick answers below:

- Baseline month: December: ~95M tokens (we're still instrumenting).
- Month3 estimate: 130M tokens. Month6 estimate: 210M tokens (we expect a feature launch in Q2 that increases usage).
- Peak TPS: we've measured spikes up to ~18 TPS for short windows (30–60s) during report generation. Sustained steady-state TPS is more like 4–6 TPS.
- Target unit economics: we are aiming for <= $350 per 1M tokens (total cost including inference + infra overhead). If we can hit $300 that would be ideal but might be optimistic.
- SLA: standard enterprise SLA, nothing beyond regional US data residency. SOC 2 is required.

Attached is our rough traffic export for Nov/Dec and a short note on the feature timeline.

Cheers,
Samir
CTO (Acting) | Apex Health
samir@apexhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0127

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@apexhealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: usage snapshot & $/1M target

Samir — thanks, this is super helpful. I pulled the numbers into our recommendation worksheet and sketched two commercial options:

Option A — Committed hosted plan (recommended for predictability):
- Commit: 120M tokens / month
- Target effective price: $330 per 1M tokens (net of standard volume discount & initial pilot credit)
- Peak TPS: we will guarantee 20 TPS burst buffer for 90s windows; sustained SLO aligned with 6 TPS.
- Includes SOC 2 evidence and US data residency.

Option B — Pay-as-you-go + burst buffer:
- No monthly commit, standard pay-as-you-go rate but with automated burst routing to handle up to 25 TPS (subject to credits).
- Effective price near $400 per 1M tokens at your forecasted monthly volume.

Notes on unit economics and cost levers:
- With your 6–18 TPS profile, intelligent batching and prefix caching can reduce effective token spend ~8–12% for typical summaries. We’ll include Optimize recommendations in the pilot.
- If you can commit to 6–9 months and provide a simple forecast cadence, we can move the committed price toward $300 per 1M tokens subject to exec approval.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a two-slide pricing summary + short pilot SOW (attached). Please confirm which option you prefer.
2) If you like Option A, I’ll request a preliminary commercial approval from our revenue ops team and loop in procurement.
3) Pilot contract (30 days) to validate peak handling and token burn (we recommend using our hosted API).

I attached the pricing slides and the worksheet I used. If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-minute procurement alignment call next week?

Thanks — looping Ben here for quick commercial sizing.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Apex_MLPricing_Slides.pdf (pdf), apex_estimated_token_volumes.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-05T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Apex Health target pricing ask (RDW-2026-APX-1142)

Ben —

Looping you in with the forecast and the ask. Apex is targeting <= $350 / 1M tokens and would like $300 if we can do a 6–9 month commit. My recommended commercial posture:
- Offer Option A (120M commit) at $330 / 1M as the standard commercial proposal.
- If procurement pushes back, we can consider an executive discount down to $300 / 1M if they commit to 9 months and provide 30 days' notice for scale changes; this would require approval from RevOps and a one-time pilot credit (~$12k).

Key risks: fast ramp to 210M by month 6 (need burst capacity) and ensuring our burst guarantees don't materially impact infra economics. Also confirm SOC 2 evidence is in the procurement pack.

Can you advise if we have room to go to $300 with the pilot credit and a 9-month commit? If yes, I’ll draft the commercial request and route it.

Thanks,
Marissa
